title: East Maui ditch system ownership and county takeover bid
summary: As of September 18, 2026, there was nothing new to report on land negotiations for the East Maui irrigation system. On August 14, the state Board of Land and Natural Resources (BLNR) voted unanimously, all six members present, to deny its staff's recommendation to start a long-term water license for Mahi Pono, which keeps alive the county's effort, through the East Maui Water Authority, to take over management. Ownership of the system remains disputed.
